scenarios.text: For reviewed repository work on a budget, test GLM 5.3 Flash; retain Sol or Opus for difficult failures and high-stakes review. Flash’s lower tariff does not erase their measured coding advantage.
scenarios.title: Coding

scenarios.text: For inexpensive tool loops, try DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with Standard Harness, or GLM Flash with ZCode/Claude Code. Validate your repository before running multi-hour autonomous work.
scenarios.title: Agents and tool use

scenarios.text: For document-plus-code or video-grounded reasoning, test Step 5 Preview or Kimi K3. Large context is useful but does not guarantee reliable retrieval or sustained task completion.
scenarios.title: Long context

scenarios.text: For the lowest uncached text tariff in this set, choose GLM 5.3 Flash. For cache-heavy workloads, compare DeepSeek Flash’s peak and off-peak cache rates. A cheap model can still cost more after retries.
scenarios.title: Lowest cost

scenarios.text: For reference-led audiovisual storytelling, test Seedance 2.5. Wan 3.0 ranks higher and costs less on this T2V board; Veo and Kling remain workflow alternatives, not automatic quality upgrades.
